has_more.title: Has More
has_more.description: Whether there are more conversations to retrieve.

continuation_token.title: Continuation Token
continuation_token.description: A token to supply to the next request to retrieve the next page of conversations. Only populated if `has_more` is `True`.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: The identifier of the user who started this conversation.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: The timestamp at which this conversation was started.

is_analyzed.title: Is Analyzed
is_analyzed.description: Whether the conversation has gone through the post-conversation analysis after finishing.

completed_post_processings.title: Completed Post Processings
completed_post_processings.description: A list of post-processing types that have been completed for this conversation.

final_message.title: Final Message
final_message.description:
The most recent message from the conversation.

This field is empty if the authenticated user has no `Conversation:GetMessage` permission on the final message.

service_id.title: Service Id
service_id.description: The ID of the service that this conversation uses.

version_set_info.description: Info of the service version set that this conversation uses. This field is only populated if the authenticated user has the `Service.GetVersionSet` permission on the version set.

num_messages.title: Num Messages
num_messages.description: The number of messages in this conversation.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: The tags associated with this conversation.

llm_name.title: Llm Name
llm_name.description: The name of the LLM to use.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the version set. If the value is `unknown`, it means the conversation was created before this field was introduced and the version set name cannot be retroactively determined.

agent_version_info.title: Agent Version Info
agent_version_info.description: The ID of the agent and version number used in this conversation.

service_hierarchical_state_machine_versi.title: Service Hierarchical State Machine Version Info
service_hierarchical_state_machine_versi.description: The ID of the state machine and version number used in this conversation.

llm_model_preferences.title: Llm Model Preferences
llm_model_preferences.description: The LLM model preferences for this version set.
